fato_historico: 1993: A Transair Georgian Airlines Tu-154 is shot down by a missile in Sukhumi, Georgia.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you may embrace deep inner renewal today. Just as the horizon shifts through light and shadow, consider how your past resilience serves as a beacon. It is a good time to release old burdens, perhaps allowing your spirit to soar freely, finding beauty in the quiet strength that emerges even when the world seems turbulent.
frase_do_dia: Strength blooms brightest when we choose to rise above the shifting shadows.
significado_numero: A powerful representation of infinite cycles and personal transformation.
conselho: Focus on nurturing your inner peace and trust in your natural healing process.
